errors.name: AlreadyInitialized
errors.description: Contract already has an admin

errors.name: NotInitialized
errors.description: Contract not yet initialized

errors.name: NotAuthorized
errors.description: Caller lacks permission

errors.name: NotRegistered
errors.description: Username not in registry

errors.name: AlreadyVerified
errors.description: Username already verified

errors.name: NotVerified
errors.description: Cannot revoke verification because the username is not verified

errors.name: Paused
errors.description: Contract is paused for maintenance or emergency

errors.name: CooldownActive
errors.description: Upgrade cooldown period has not elapsed

errors.name: InvalidVersion
errors.description: Target version is not higher than current version

errors.name: InvalidRole
errors.description: Invalid or unauthorized role assignment

errors.name: InvalidUsername
errors.description: Username is empty, over `max_username_len`, or contains disallowed characters

errors.name: AttestationExpired
errors.description: Upgrade attestation's `expires_at` has passed

errors.name: UnattestedWasm
errors.description: `upgrade` hash does not match the live attestation

errors.name: InvalidBatchSize
errors.description: Batch call supplied zero items or more than the configured max

errors.name: InvalidReasonCode
errors.description: `revoke_verification` reason_code is not a known `RevokeReason` value

errors.name: ZeroAddress
errors.description: Supplied Stellar address is the well-known zero/burn address

errors.name: ChallengeAlreadyActive
errors.description: `start_challenge` called while a challenge is already open

errors.name: NoChallengeActive
errors.description: `cancel_challenge` or `complete_challenge` called with no active challenge

errors.name: ChallengeNotResolvable
errors.description: `complete_challenge` called before the delay has elapsed

errors.name: ChallengeActive
errors.description: `register` attempted while a challenge is active on the username

errors.name: InvalidPauseReason
errors.description: `pause` / `unpause` / `set_paused` given an unrecognized reason code

errors.name: AlreadyReserved
errors.description: `add_reserved` for a username already on the reserved list

errors.name: NotReserved
errors.description: `remove_reserved` for a username not on the reserved list

errors.name: UsernameReserved
errors.description: `register` for a username on the reserved list

errors.name: ReservedListFull
errors.description: Reserved list has reached its maximum size

errors.name: AdminTransferPending
errors.description: `propose_admin_transfer` while a transfer is already pending

errors.name: AdminTransferDelayActive
errors.description: `execute_admin_transfer` before the delay has elapsed

errors.name: NoPendingAdminTransfer
errors.description: `execute_admin_transfer` with no pending proposal

errors.name: AttestationRequired
errors.description: `upgrade` without an attestation while attestation-required mode is on

errors.name: NetworkMismatch
errors.description: Instance state was initialized on a different network than the one executing (Issue #231 / #401)

errors.name: VerifierAllowlistFull
errors.description: `add_verifier` would exceed the `MAX_VERIFIERS` cap (Issue #293)

errors.name: VerifierNotAllowlisted
errors.description: `remove_verifier` for an address not on the allowlist (Issue #293)

errors.name: VerifierExpiryInPast
errors.description: `add_verifier` given a non-zero `expires_at` not in the future (Issue #293)

errors.name: NoPendingRoleGrant
errors.description: `activate_role` / `cancel_role_grant` with no pending grant (Issue #220)

errors.name: RoleGrantNotReady
errors.description: `activate_role` before the grant's timelock elapsed (Issue #220)

errors.name: ProvenanceMissing
errors.description: `assert_build` / `set_provenance_digests` before any provenance record exists (Issue #225)

errors.name: ProvenanceMismatch
errors.description: `assert_build` given a hash that does not match stored provenance (Issue #225)

errors.name: StagedWasmMismatch
errors.description: `upgrade` / `execute_upgrade` was given a WASM hash that does not match the staged-WASM slot (Issue #300)

errors.name: UpgradeProposalAlreadyPending
errors.description: `propose_multisig_upgrade` was called while a proposal is already live (Issue #301)

errors.name: NoUpgradeProposalPending
errors.description: `approve_upgrade` / `execute_upgrade` / `cancel_upgrade_proposal` was called with no live proposal (or a proposal id that does not match) (Issue #301)

errors.name: UpgradeProposalAlreadyApproved
errors.description: `approve_upgrade` was called by an address that already approved this proposal (Issue #301)

errors.name: UpgradeProposalDelayActive
errors.description: `execute_upgrade` was called before the proposal's delay elapsed (Issue #301)

errors.name: UpgradeProposalInsufficientApprovals
errors.description: `execute_upgrade` was called before the approval threshold was met (Issue #301)

errors.name: FallbackListFull
errors.description: `register` was given more fallback addresses than `MAX_FALLBACK_ADDRESSES`

errors.name: UsernameTaken
errors.description: `rename` was called with a `new_username` that is already registered

errors.name: RotationRequired
errors.description: `register` was asked to change the registered address while the rotation delay is armed (Issue #234) — use the request/execute rotation flow

errors.name: RotationPending
errors.description: A rotation is already pending for this username (Issue #234)

errors.name: NoRotationPending
errors.description: `execute_address_rotation` / `cancel_address_rotation` was called with no pending rotation (Issue #234)

errors.name: RotationNotReady
errors.description: `execute_address_rotation` was called before the delay has elapsed (Issue #234)

errors.name: InvalidCursor
errors.description: A pagination cursor no longer decodes against the current registry state (Issue #215)

errors.name: VerifyRateLimited
errors.description: A non-admin caller would exceed its per-ledger verify/revoke cap (Issue #292)

errors.name: DualControlRequired
errors.description: `batch_remove` was called with a batch larger than the configured dual-control threshold (Issue #219) — use `propose_batch_remove` / `execute_batch_remove` instead

errors.name: BatchRemoveProposalPending
errors.description: `propose_batch_remove` was called while a proposal is already pending (Issue #219)

errors.name: NoPendingBatchRemove
errors.description: `execute_batch_remove` / `cancel_batch_remove` was called with no live (or already-expired) proposal (Issue #219)

errors.name: RoleExpired
errors.description: A role-gated privileged invocation was made at or after the role's expiry timestamp

errors.name: OracleProofBadLayout
errors.description: `verify_with_oracle_proof` given an empty message, all-zero signature, or a message not bound to the username/address/expiry (Issue #584)

errors.name: OracleProofNotAllowlisted
errors.description: `verify_with_oracle_proof` signed by a key not on the oracle allowlist (Issue #584)

errors.name: OracleProofExpired
errors.description: `verify_with_oracle_proof` with a non-zero `expires_at` in the past (Issue #584)

errors.name: OracleProofBadSignature
errors.description: `verify_with_oracle_proof` with a non-canonical signature encoding (Issue #584)

events.name: RegisteredEvent
events.data: { stellar_address, timestamp, sponsor: Option<Address>, domain: EventDomain }

events.name: BotStatusChangedEvent
events.data: { is_bot: bool, actor: Address, timestamp, domain: EventDomain }
